answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, with transition probabilities multiplied along each traversed edge. A sybil cluster may inflate internal links, but honest-to-sybil edges form a sparse external cut; its low conductance limits walk entry and escape, while min-cut transitivity bounds the cluster’s aggregate voting weight. Thus a sparrow signal, tide of endorsements, or nebula of identities cannot evade the cut without credible cross-attestations.
